verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents an app marketplace ('Over 1,200 apps to help you grow') and developer APIs to build single-click marketplace apps, but there's no detail on vetting/curation processes, and a hands-on community report describes the app ecosystem as 'rather incomplete' with API reliability issues. missing for 10: vetting/curation details, marketplace category breadth evidence, more recent independent corroboration of app quality/coverage.
